senses.gloss: m. ch. = h.נָכְרִי , strange; stranger; gentile.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 6:1">Targ. Prov. VI, 1</cite>.

<cite ref="Onkelos Deuteronomy 17:15">Targ. O. Deut. XVII, 15</cite>; a. fr.—[<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 11:17">Targ. Prov. XI, 17</cite>; <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 17:11">XVII, 11</cite> <cite ref="N00359"><he>נוכריא</he></cite> some ed., v. <cite ref="N00816"><he>נַכְזְרָיָא</he></cite>.]—
<cite ref="Shabbat 65b:2">Sabb. 65ᵇ</cite> <he>גופא נוכראה</he> another person’s body, v. <cite ref="C00458"><he>גּוּפָא</he></cite>.—Pl. <he>נוּכְרָאִין</he>.
Targ. Lam. V, 2; a. e.—Fem. נוּכְרָאָה, נוּכְרָיָיא, נוּכְרֵיתָא.
Targ. Job XIX, 17; a. e.—Esp. נוּכְרֵיתָא a gentile woman.
Targ. Prov. V, 20; a. fr.—[Ib. XXVII, 4 נוכריתא Ms. abomination (Pesh. מְרַחַקְתָּא), ed. נִכְזְרָיוּתָא.]—Pl. נוּכְרָאָן, נוּכְרֵיָיתָא.
